name: Mountain Resort and its Outlying Temples, Chengde
description: Built between 1703 and 1792 in Hebei Province, about 225 km northeast of Beijing, this was the Qing emperors' summer retreat. Palaces, ceremonial halls and imperial gardens are spread across a landscape of lakes, meadows and wooded hills. Temples in several architectural styles stand nearby, so a single visit takes in gardens, pagodas and halls drawn from many regions of China.
